messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 2-3 year commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote and for being open about your capacity. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, and the attached packages offer exactly that: our full annual volume, bound for 24 or 36 months, which secures your utilisation.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 shows demand rising by 10.1 %. Our should-cost estimate cost:340010 puts this seal at EUR 24.31 per unit before margin. Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 79.5 %, so a firm lead time matters to us.

What is the earliest lead time you can confirm for a fixed call-off schedule? Is there a cheaper variant of this seal you would recommend?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 2-3 year commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your should-cost estimate and forecast; however, our pricing reflects our current high utilisation.

For a firm commitment of 23,400 units over 36 months with a 56-day lead time, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. Our offer remains valid for 30 days. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

Our technical colleagues will address your inquiry regarding alternative seal variants.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Application Engineering: We build to your drawing; we do not propose design changes.

messages.subject: Part 340010 – firm 36-month commitment, request for pricing review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for the revised offer and the delivery schedule. To confirm our commitment: 23,400 pieces per year, bound for 36 months, called off in equal monthly quantities as in your schedule. This gives you the firm, long-term volume you prioritise and fills your planning for three years.

The attached packages offer you a choice between the 42-day lead time we need for our assembly plan and your 56-day lead time.

Could you submit these packages to the committee at its next meeting?

Could you also confirm whether 42 days is feasible with the fixed call-off schedule?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010 – firm 36-month commitment, request for pricing review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Regarding our current procedure, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For the 56-day lead time, we propose a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

Please provide the underlying data for your volume assertions. Which volume can you commit to? We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010 – firm 36-month commitment, request for pricing review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
